title: Tablet Friend layout
description: A Tablet Friend toolbar layout. Buttons are packed in declaration order.

layout_width.description: Maximum number of button cells per row before wrapping.

button_size.description: Size in pixels of one button cell, excluding its margin.

min_opacity.description: Toolbar opacity while unfocused. Must not exceed max_opacity.

max_opacity.description: Toolbar opacity while focused. Must not be below min_opacity.

app.description: Optional case-insensitive process name, with * wildcards, for automatic switching.

buttons.description: Named buttons and spacers, shown in declaration order. Names must be unique.

action.description: One key chord or action command; see docs/keys.md and the sample layout.

actions.description: Action commands executed in order. Cannot be combined with action.

press_and_hold.description: Hold a plain key chord while the button is pressed.

quick_press_toggle.description: A short tap locks or unlocks a press-and-hold key.

quick_press_threshold_ms.description: Taps shorter than this duration lock the key; requires press_and_hold.

text.description: Button label, or tooltip when an icon is present. Use \n for line breaks.

icon.description: Material Design icon name or PNG/SVG path.

icon_stretch.description: How a custom image fills the button.

size.description: Width,height in positive button cells, for example 2,1.

style.description: Named visual style; omitted means the current theme's default.

visibility.description: Docking modes in which this button appears.

spacer.description: Reserve empty cells instead of drawing a button.
